_comment: ai-reviewer-start-watch settings. run_on_host: the ONE machine (hostname) that reroutes shared-db reviewers that were drawn but never started; every other machine's tick is a no-op and schedule refuses there, so two machines never race the same reroute. repo: the shared-db repository the watcher acts on. schedule_every_minutes: the pass interval; the start SLO is 10 minutes, so a non-start is rerouted within SLO + this interval. lock_stale_minutes: an overlapping tick is refused until the lock is this old. log_max_bytes: tick.log rotates to tick.log.1 past this size. preflight_timeout_ms: exported as REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS for the watcher; drawing a replacement runs `ai-review-preflight usable`, which took ~80 s on edge-dev (2026-09-18) against shared-db's 60 s default, and a cut-off run drops the later providers and refuses the draw. Override the whole file with AI_REVIEWER_START_WATCH_CONFIG.
